title: Can Non-Coders Build Better Apps? Claude Code Research Revealed!
description: Claude Code analyzed 400,000 user sessions to answer one question: Are developers actually better at using AI for coding? The results were shocking. The research shows that people who are NOT coders often create better products when they understand the specific problem better than a developer. If you understand the nuances of a problem, you can guide AI to the perfect product. Watch to see why your domain expertise is your new superpower in the age of AI.
